interpretation: Repeat departure is a text change, not semantic or cognitive recovery. Counts deduplicate shared nodes; branches remain correlated. Endpoint-valid subsets are selected samples, not unconditional causal effects.

rules.cap_rule: Recorded output_cap is observed; capped text is partial; descendants remain unavailable.
rules.exact_repeat_text: Byte-equivalent Unicode strings; nonempty after whitespace check; both speakers in actual ancestry.
rules.line_rule: Strip each line and omit empty lines; count occurrences of identical lines, including nonadjacent ones.
rules.repeat_action: Observe and continue; no online stopping or replacement.
rules.scope: Prospective mechanical definitions informed by development evidence; retrospective applications are descriptive.
rules.semantic_rule: No semantic labels. Valid repetition is observable text; invalid and blocked messages are not semantic negatives.
